lang.name: English
hero.title:
Reset your body.
Keep it simple.
hero.subtitle: Keto-led organic food, sauna & cold plunge, daily sea, and real rest. High protein, no sugar, no fluff — just a body that feels good again.
pillars.title:
Physical wellness.
Nothing you don't need.
pillars.lead: Saltstone is for people who want to feel better in their body — not find themselves. Evidence-based, keto-led, grounded, and genuinely Gozitan.
pillars.items.food.title: Keto-Led Food
pillars.items.food.desc: High protein, high quality fat, zero sugar, minimal carbs. Fresh local fish, Gozitan meat, eggs, and seasonal vegetables. No bread, no pasta, no compromise.
pillars.items.sauna.title: Sauna & Cold Plunge
pillars.items.sauna.desc: Hot-cold contrast therapy for recovery, circulation and nervous system reset. Morning and evening sessions.
pillars.items.movement.title: Movement
pillars.items.movement.desc: Light daily exercise — swimming, walks along the cliffs, gentle morning mobility. No gym, no performance pressure.
pillars.items.boat.title: Daily Boat Trip
pillars.items.boat.desc: Free, every day. Comino, the Blue Lagoon, sea caves, snorkel spots. The Mediterranean as your therapy pool.
pillars.items.detox.title: Herbal Detox
pillars.items.detox.desc: Freshly pressed juices, herbal teas and detox smoothies. Gozo's wild herbs — rosemary, fennel, sea lavender.
pillars.items.rest.title: Real Rest
pillars.items.rest.desc: No schedule you don't want. Hammocks, terraces, sea views. Unstructured time that actually restores you.
recovery.title:
Heat, water,
then quiet.
recovery.lead: Sauna and cold plunge sessions sit between boat trips, clean food, and slow evenings. Nothing ceremonial, nothing complicated — just dry heat, cold water, and space to come down.
recovery.sauna.title: Sauna
recovery.sauna.desc: Dry heat for circulation, recovery, and a deeper night of sleep.
food.title:
Real food.
No sugar. No shortcuts.
food.p1: Every meal at Saltstone is built around a ketogenic, high-protein approach. We're not a vegetarian holiday, and we're not apologising for it. Meat, fish, eggs, and quality fats are the foundation — sourced from Gozitan farmers and the Mediterranean sea.
food.p2: No refined sugar. Grains, bread, pasta and rice are kept to a minimum — not forbidden, but never the focus. Just food that works with your body — reducing inflammation, stabilising energy, and letting you feel what it's like to be genuinely well-fed without the crash.
food.bullets.fats: Organic olive oil, avocado, nuts & seeds
food.bullets.broths: Bone broths, herbal detox teas & electrolyte drinks
food.bullets.minimal: Minimal sugar, grains, bread, pasta & rice — not eliminated, but kept very low
food.bullets.not_vegan: Not vegetarian or vegan — our holidays are meat & fish forward
food.meals.breakfast.title: Breakfast
food.meals.breakfast.desc: Eggs your way, smoked fish, avocado, grilled tomatoes, olive oil, black coffee or herbal tea.
food.meals.dinner.title: Dinner
food.meals.dinner.desc: Slow-roasted Gozitan lamb or beef, charred greens, herb-infused oils, and a clean finish — no dessert, no regrets.
food.meals.snacks.title: Snacks
food.meals.snacks.desc: Nuts, olives, hard cheese, charcuterie, herbal teas. Nothing processed. Nothing that spikes your blood sugar.
food.note.title: A note on dietary requirements:
food.note.body: Our food programme is intentionally keto and meat-forward. If you follow a strict vegetarian or vegan diet, Saltstone may not be the right fit — and we'd rather be honest about that upfront. Pescatarians are very well catered for. If you have specific allergies or intolerances, get in touch and we'll do our best.

packages.lead: All packages include accommodation, keto breakfast and dinner, boat trips, sauna access, and movement sessions.

gozo.title: Why Gozo?
gozo.p1: Gozo is Malta's quieter, greener sister island — a 20-minute ferry from the world, but a different rhythm entirely. The kind of place where you slow down without trying.
gozo.p2: The island has a deep organic farming culture, pristine sea, dramatic cliffs, ancient temples, and a pace of life that makes rest feel natural rather than forced.
gozo.fact.width: Wide — a whole world in a small island
